Join the our affiliate and influencer program today!

 How does it work?
Simple and effective

 1
Signup for free

Signup below by email and join our fast growing community of affiliates.

 2
Sell our tours via

Qr Code, link, social media post, word of mouth, near field communication(nfc).  Word of mouth is the most powerful, just mention it to your table, visitors or friends using a unique link.

 3
Earn 10% commission for each activity sale

We will pay a commission for each sale referred by you via link/dashboard/qr code/nfc bump or word of mouth that comes from your unique code! Get paid automatically to your bank account. View your sales on your dashboard if you are curious.
